title: Eternally Regressing Knight
altTitles: The Knight Who Only Lives Today
The Knight Who Lives Only Today
死に戻り騎士は今日も生きる
Le chevalier qui ne vit qu'aujourd'hui
O Cavaleiro que Vive Apenas Hoje
description: Encrid has always dreamed of becoming a knight, but everyone around him believes his talent is too poor for him to ever succeed. Despite the ridicule, he refuses to abandon his dream and trains relentlessly. One day, he is killed by a sword through the neck. Yet instead of dying, Encrid awakens to the morning of the same day. With every death sending him back to the beginning, he gains another opportunity to train, fight, learn, and gradually become the knight he always dreamed of being.
author: Lee Hyun-min / Ganala / Soulpung
